@@ -328,6 +328,25 @@ jobs:
           cp "parser/flix-parser-${RELEASE_TAG}.jar" rewrite/rewrite-flix/libs/flix-facade.jar
           echo "supplied $(du -h rewrite/rewrite-flix/libs/flix-facade.jar | cut -f1) parser jar"
 
+      # Install the parser under a real Maven coordinate so it travels in the
+      # bundle. rewrite-flix builds against the file in libs/, which cannot reach
+      # its published POM -- Gradle has no coordinate to write for a local file --
+      # so a consumer would resolve rewrite-flix with no parser behind it and fail
+      # at first parse. Publishing it here, and passing -PflixParserVersion below,
+      # is what makes the bundle self-contained.
+      - name: Install the parser as a Maven artifact
+        env:
+          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.tag }}
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          mvn -q -B org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-install-plugin:3.1.2:install-file \
+            -Dfile="parser/flix-parser-${RELEASE_TAG}.jar" \
+            -DgroupId=org.openrewrite.vendor \
+            -DartifactId=flix-parser \
+            -Dversion="${RELEASE_TAG}" \
+            -Dpackaging=jar
+          test -f "$HOME/.m2/repository/org/openrewrite/vendor/flix-parser/${RELEASE_TAG}/flix-parser-${RELEASE_TAG}.jar"
+
       # The real consumability proof: rewrite-flix compiles against the jar and
       # its suite runs, including the round-trip sweep over the whole Flix corpus.
       - name: Test rewrite-flix against the parser jar
@@ -365,8 +384,11 @@ jobs:
 
       - name: Publish required Rewrite modules locally
         working-directory: rewrite
+        env:
+          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.validate.outputs.tag }}
         run: >-
           ./gradlew
+          -PflixParserVersion="${RELEASE_TAG}"
           :rewrite-core:publishToMavenLocal
           :rewrite-java:publishToMavenLocal
           :rewrite-java-21:publishToMavenLocal
@@ -385,6 +407,9 @@ jobs:
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
           mkdir -p dist/m2-repository/org
+          # Both subtrees: the rewrite modules, and the parser they now depend on
+          # by coordinate. Shipping one without the other is what made the last
+          # bundle unusable.
           cp -R "$HOME/.m2/repository/org/openrewrite" dist/m2-repository/org/
           tar -C dist -czf "dist/rewrite-m2-${RELEASE_TAG}.tar.gz" m2-repository
           rm -rf dist/m2-repository
@@ -419,15 +444,6 @@ jobs:
           REWRITE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.rewrite.outputs.rewrite_commit }}
         run: |
           set -euo pipefail
-          cat > "release/manifest-${RELEASE_TAG}.json" <<EOF
-          {
-            "releaseTag": "${RELEASE_TAG}",
-            "buildPlatform": "linux-amd64",
-            "flixCommit": "${FLIX_COMMIT}",
-            "rewriteCommit": "${REWRITE_COMMIT}",
-            "files": {}
-          }
-          EOF
           (
             cd release
             # `shasum` is available on both GitHub's Linux and Intel macOS
@@ -438,6 +454,44 @@ jobs:
               "rewrite-m2-${RELEASE_TAG}.tar.gz" > "SHA256SUMS-${RELEASE_TAG}.txt"
           )
 
+          # `files` used to be an empty object -- a field that claimed to describe
+          # the release and described nothing. It now carries each payload's size
+          # and digest, so the manifest alone identifies what shipped. The platform
+          # is read from the runner rather than asserted as a literal, which was
+          # metadata nothing checked.
+          python3 - "release" "${RELEASE_TAG}" "${FLIX_COMMIT}" "${REWRITE_COMMIT}" \
+                    "$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')-$(uname -m)" <<'PY'
+          import hashlib, json, pathlib, sys
+
+          directory, tag, flix_commit, rewrite_commit, platform = sys.argv[1:6]
+          release = pathlib.Path(directory)
+
+          payloads = [
+              f"flix-{tag}.jar",
+              f"flix-parser-{tag}.jar",
+              f"rewrite-m2-{tag}.tar.gz",
+              f"SHA256SUMS-{tag}.txt",
+          ]
+
+          files = {}
+          for name in payloads:
+              path = release / name
+              files[name] = {
+                  "bytes": path.stat().st_size,
+                  "sha256": hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+              }
+
+          manifest = {
+              "releaseTag": tag,
+              "buildPlatform": platform,
+              "flixCommit": flix_commit,
+              "rewriteCommit": rewrite_commit,
+              "files": files,
+          }
+          (release / f"manifest-{tag}.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
+          print(f"manifest describes {len(files)} files on {platform}")
+          PY
+
       - name: Create immutable GitHub Release
         env:
           GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
